name: Who's My Manito?
source:
A shy Secret Santa who I have to take care of, and a secret Secret Santa who surprises me with gifts! In the conflicting Secret Santa games, who will win the rookie's heart? 

[From [url=https://store.onstove.com/en/games/102913]Stove[/url]]
